title: The Khalsa Resolve to Defend Amritsar from the Sacred Shrines

blocks.text: This page records the inner debate over where the Khalsa should make its stand. The argument that wins is spiritual as much as military: it is better to die near the Guru's shrines than to seek a safer but less meaningful refuge elsewhere.

The discussion turns repeatedly to the sanctity of Amritsar and the memory attached to its sacred places. Instead of abandoning the center of Sikh devotion, the Singhs weigh the five holy sites and imagine defense growing out of the geography blessed by the Gurus themselves.

By the end of the page, the decision is moving toward action. The sacred shrines of Amritsar are no longer only places of pilgrimage; they are becoming the ground from which a new fortification will be raised.
